Control Sequence Design - NaCl Evaporation Plant, Rev B
Synthetic hackathon engineering evidence
1. Controller architecture
The central controller is implemented as a StateGraph-style sequential function chart. A single sensors connector bundles measured process values and a single actuators connector bundles automated valve, pump and thermal commands. Plant-level equations assign individual instrument values into the sensor bundle and actuator values to component commands.
Manual/isolation valves shown on the P&ID are intentionally excluded from the normal StateGraph actuator bundle unless specifically stated in the ICD.
2. State sequence
State | Action | Guard/transition | Region
Initial | All automated valves closed; pumps/heaters/coolers off | startEnable AND B3 available | Single
Step1 | V8=OPEN | LIS-301 >= 0.13 m | Single
Step2 | V9=OPEN | QI-302 >= 0.080 kg/kg | Single
Step3 | V11=OPEN | LIS-301 < 0.01 m | Single
Step4 | No transfer actuator | LIS-501 <0.01 m AND NOT V15 | Single
Step5 | V12=OPEN | LIS-501 >=0.18 m | Single
Step6 | B5_Heater=ON | QIS-502 >=0.180 kg/kg | Single
Step12 | B6_Cooler=ON | TIS-602 <=20 degC | Parallel A
Step13 | P2=ON + corrected B1 return valve group | B6 return complete | Parallel A
Step7 | No transfer actuator | LIS-701 <0.01 m | Parallel B
Step8 | V15=OPEN | LIS-501 <0.01 m | Parallel B
Step9 | B7_Cooler=ON | TIS-702 <=25 degC | Parallel B
Step10/11 | P1=ON + corrected B2 return valve group | B7 return complete | Parallel B
Join | No transfer actuator | A complete AND B complete AND time>2500 s | Join
3. Parallel branch behavior
Step6 completion creates two concurrent branches. Branch A cools the condensate in B6 and then returns it. Branch B waits for B7 availability, transfers B5 concentrate to B7, cools it, then returns it. A join is satisfied only when both branches report completion.
4. Heater and pump interlocks
B5 heater permissive: LIS-501 >= 0.05 m AND FIS-801 >= 0.10 kg/s.
P1 permissive: LIS-701 > 0.02 m. Low discharge pressure alarm if PIS-901 < 0.8 bar(g) while running.
P2 permissive: LIS-601 > 0.02 m. Low discharge pressure alarm if PIS-1001 < 0.8 bar(g) while running.
Automated valves fail closed and are not treated as modulating valves.
5. Return-routing revision note
IMPORTANT: The archived StateGraph extract paired the B7/P1 branch with the B1 valve group and the B6/P2 branch with the B2 valve group. CR-017 subsequently corrected the destination semantics: recovered condensate from B6 returns to B1, and cooled concentrate from B7 returns to B2. Controller valve-group assignments shall follow CR-017.
6. Example textual signal assignments
controller.sensors.LIS_301 = B3.level;
controller.sensors.QIS_502 = B5.medium.Xi[NaCl];
V9.open = controller.actuators.V9;
HeatB5.Q_flow = if controller.actuators.T5_Heater then 20000 else 0;
